column3: MT 45:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts “Korah. A Song of Love.” in parentheses. “I am speaking my works to the king” is rendered “I address my verses to the King,” and “a skilled scribe” as “a ready writer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “handsome” is rendered “fairer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “prosper, ride” is rendered “ride on victoriously.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB repeats “Your arrows are” in the third line.
Close to the Hebrew; “Your companions” is rendered “Your fellows.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “are fragrant with.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the queen-consort” is rendered “the queen.”
NASB supplies “will come,” and renders “they will entreat your face” as “will entreat your favor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “of settings of gold” is rendered “interwoven with gold.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your children” is rendered “your sons,” and “the land” as “the earth.”
